name: Zenet-Mose Nekhbet
effectText: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Zenet" card. Cannot be destroyed by battle, while equipped with an Equip Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenet-Mose Nekhbet" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your GY to your hand, except "Zenet-Mose Nekhbet". (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 face-up Normal Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, equip this card you control to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 2500 ATK.
